# Test fixtures

Tiny hand-made files for tests and for building in parallel. They are **not data**:
not real, not generated by the synthetic generator, and not results of any model.
Every id starts with `FIX-` so a fixture can never be mistaken for anything else.

| Folder | What it holds | Who uses it |
|---|---|---|
| `contract/` | One CSV per table of the data contract (`src/adapters/base.py`, `CONTRACT`) | ML teammate: labels, split and metrics before the generator exists |
| `api/` | Sample JSON for each API response (`src/api/schemas.py`) | Full-stack teammate: the React dashboard and the API before the model exists |
| `taiwan_cc/` | `sample.csv`: eight hand-made clients with the columns of the UCI Taiwan credit-card file (numeric ids 1 to 8, as in the source). Not rows from the real file | Tests of the `taiwan_cc` adapter and features |
| `india_ltfs/` | `train.csv`: eight hand-made loans with the 41 columns of the L&T vehicle loan file (numeric ids 1001 to 1008). Not rows from the real file | Tests of the `india_ltfs` adapter and features |

The six fixture merchants cover the cases the product must handle:

| Merchant | Case |
|---|---|
| FIX-M001 | Full history in all streams, repaid on time |
| FIX-M002 | Good payer with no delivery data |
| FIX-M003 | One loan repaid 67 days late (label 0), one repaid 10 days late (label 1) |
| FIX-M004 | Thin file: onboarded recently, one purchase, loan too young to have an outcome |
| FIX-M005 | Consent withdrawn: must not be scored |
| FIX-M006 | Unpaid loan (label 0) |

`tests/test_fixtures.py` checks that these files still match the contract and the API shapes.
Never put real or downloaded data in this folder.
